paragraphs: Quiz Mode uses the local quiz bank that ships with the app. Your recent quiz history is stored on-device so the More tab can show recent sessions and weak areas.
sections.title: How does Quiz Mode work?

paragraphs: Flashcard progress, review timing, pinned focus topics, reminders, recent briefs, and recent decks are stored locally on your device. The app uses that local history to power the More tab, Home, and deck review flow.
sections.title: What is stored on my device?

paragraphs: Recent Briefs and Recent Flashcard Sets are activity history, not permanent bookmarks. They update when you open resources and decks through the app.
sections.title: Are Recent Briefs and Recent Flashcard Sets saved collections?

paragraphs: Instructor reviews, review reports, feedback, feature requests, support requests, and incorrect gouge reports sync through the Cloudflare backend when a backend URL is configured and your device is online. If not, the app queues supported submissions locally until it can retry.
sections.title: When does the app send data to the backend?

paragraphs: Notifications are local daily reminders only in this MVP. The app schedules them on-device after you grant notification permission.
sections.title: How do notifications work?

paragraphs: Use Support for app issues or help requests. Use Feedback for general thoughts, Request a Feature for product ideas, and Report Incorrect Gouge for content that looks wrong, outdated, or incomplete.
sections.title: Which support option should I use?
